scenarios.title: New messages reach every active client view
steps: web sends text through Core SDK
flutter observes ReceivedBatch and updates conversation preview
flutter observes the same message in the active timeline
web and flutter converge on the same conversationSeq

scenarios.title: Read positions roam by user and device
steps: flutter marks the conversation read with readSeq
core sends conversation.markRead as ReadAck with the effective device id
web syncs the read state and clears unread for the same conversation
both clients expose the same lastReadSeq

scenarios.title: Draft text roams through ConversationUserSettingsSync
steps: web updates the draft through conversation.updateDraft
core persists the draft and pushes ConversationUserSettingsSync.draft
flutter reloads the conversation settings
both clients show the same draft text for the conversation

scenarios.title: Device management targets the exact device id
steps: web lists current user devices
web kicks the selected flutter device id
flutter receives the session shutdown for that device
web remains connected because the active device id differs

scenarios.title: Typing indicators are attributed to the sending device
steps: flutter sends message.typing from its current device id
web receives RealtimeControlPacket.typing
web displays typing state for that device only
stale typing state is cleared without changing durable draft text
